1_value_and_volume.verdict: Pre-packaged, single-serving grab-and-go lunch boxes and sushi trays priced at standard high-street corporate retail rates. Offers zero banquet or feast value for sharing.

2_demographic_community.evidence: Patronized almost exclusively by local office workers and commuters looking for a rapid midday desk lunch; lacks any native diaspora presence or community hub dynamics.

3_linguistic_signal.menu_type: Standard English corporate branding and retail shelf packaging with no native linguistic elements or insider specials.

5_culinary_uncompromisingness.pander_check: Thoroughly commercialized and diluted flavor profiles designed for mainstream convenience, featuring sweetened teriyaki sauces, California rolls, and grab-and-go poke bowls.

summary_reasoning: Abokado is a daytime corporate grab-and-go chain, completely failing the establishment integrity test and lacking any cultural depth, culinary challenge, or sharing value.
